parameters.name: ConfigureMode
parameters.description:
The configuration mode. Valid values:

- ApplyOnly: The configuration is applied only once. If the configuration is updated, the configuration is reapplied.
- ApplyAndMonitor: The configuration is applied only once. After the configuration is successfully applied, only configuration drift is checked.
- ApplyAndAutoCorrect: The configuration is always applied.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the desired state configuration.

parameters.name: ScheduleExpression
parameters.description: The schedule expression. The scheduling interval must be no less than 30 minutes.

parameters.name: ScheduleType
parameters.description: The schedule type. Valid values: rate.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: TemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version number. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version is used by default.
